description: Analyze and reason over a video or image with the Cosmos Reason 8B vision-language model.
inputInstructions: Provide the analysis/reasoning prompt via the COSMOS_REASON_PROMPT file metadata key (or PROMPT in the config); a sensible default caption prompt is used when none is set. INVALIDATE_COSMOS_MODELS=true clears the cached model weights before the run. The model size is fixed by the registered pipeline.
